execution_sequence.guard: Do not create a pod unless estimated total spend remains under $100.
Must preserve MAX_SFT_STEPS=20, MAX_DPO_STEPS=10, PUSH_TO_HUB=false, REPORT_TO=none for the smoke.
Must reach ready_for_explicit_paid_judge before paid judge.
Only after integrity and dry judge pass, OPENAI_API_KEY is loaded, and total budget remains under $100.
Readiness may only turn green if all final evidence artifacts exist and validate.

paper_claim_constraints: Until this checklist passes, do not claim a trained smaller model preserves citation-grounded correctness.
Report Qwen 3B answer rate, answer support, abstention support, citation recall, and second-pass reliability slices together.
Keep the public dated-QASPER/arXiv proxy caveat unless a versioned private KB is added.
Keep abstention-boundary instability as a limitation unless human/stronger-judge adjudication closes it.

llm_budget.note: This checklist reads local artifacts only.
